raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) who builds full-stack web applications with Java, Spring Boot and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply strong fundamentals in object-oriented design and algorithms to scalable systems.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses and integrate Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the application with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with MySQL schema for booking study rooms. Piloted with 120 students over 2 weeks and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Data Structures and Algorithms through competitive programming (LeetCode, HackerRank) or algorithm-focused projects; this is a core requirement for the role.
Study and apply Object-Oriented Design principles explicitly in your projects—document design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy) you use in your code.
Build or contribute to a project involving Distributed Systems concepts (e.g., message queues, eventual consistency, sharding, or microservices) to directly address the JD emphasis.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the JD emphasizes Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Object-Oriented Design—none of which are evident in your current profile. Prioritise gaining these core CS fundamentals before applying; they are non-negotiable for this role.
